mods.name: mod-store
mods.description: An in-terminal app store: browse, search, install and update every Claude Mod from GitHub.
mods.spec: Slash command /mods opens a Pane. Fetch https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plagemes/claude-mods/main/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json (repo configurable via userConfig 'repository', default 'plagemes/claude-mods', branch 'main') with $.http.fetch, cache it in $.store with a timestamp. List mods grouped by category with search (Input), filter by category (Select), detail view (description, version, category, install line). Show which mods are installed and which have updates by running `claude plugin list --json` (or the equivalent $ API if one exists; inspect the types for $.plugin / plugins) via $.process.run. Buttons: Install (`claude plugin install <name>@claude-mods` after ensuring the marketplace is added with `claude plugin marketplace add plagemes/claude-mods`), Update, Uninstall, Open README (copy URL). After install/update toast 'run /reload-plugins'. Also /mods update-all. Graceful offline mode from cache. Works on terminal and desktop surfaces.

mods.name: secret-shield
mods.description: Blocks edits and writes that would commit API keys, tokens or private keys.
mods.spec: tool.call guard on Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit: scan new content for AWS (AKIA...), GitHub (ghp_/github_pat_), Anthropic (sk-ant-), OpenAI (sk-), Stripe (sk_live_), Slack (xox), Google API (AIza), private key PEM headers, generic high-entropy assignments to *_KEY/*_SECRET/*_TOKEN. Deny with which pattern matched and the line. .catch denies. userConfig allowlist regex.

mods.name: env-guard
mods.description: Protects .env files, SSH keys and credential stores from being read or modified.
mods.spec: tool.call guard on Read/Edit/Write/Bash(cat/less/grep on those paths): .env*, except .env.example/.env.sample; ~/.ssh/*, *.pem, *.key, id_rsa*, .aws/credentials, .npmrc with tokens, .netrc, kubeconfig. Deny with reason. .catch denies.

mods.name: rm-rf-guard
mods.description: Blocks catastrophic shell commands like rm -rf /, mkfs, dd to disks and chmod -R 777.
mods.spec: tool.call guard on Bash: normalise whitespace, detect rm -rf on /, ~, $HOME, *, .., system dirs; git reset --hard and git clean -fdx (deny unless userConfig allowGitReset); mkfs, dd of=/dev/, chmod -R 777, chown -R on /, :(){ :|:& };:, > /dev/sda. Deny with explanation and safer alternative.

mods.name: force-push-guard
mods.description: Forbids force-pushing to protected branches and suggests --force-with-lease.
mods.spec: tool.call guard on Bash: detect git push with -f/--force/+refspec targeting main/master/develop/release/* (userConfig list). Deny; for other branches rewrite --force to --force-with-lease via next({...e, command}).

mods.name: prod-guard
mods.description: Stops production-affecting commands (terraform apply, kubectl on prod, DROP TABLE) unless explicitly allowed.
mods.spec: tool.call guard on Bash: terraform apply/destroy, pulumi up/destroy, kubectl with --context/namespace matching prod regex (userConfig), helm upgrade on prod, DROP/TRUNCATE TABLE, DELETE FROM without WHERE in psql/mysql commands, aws ... delete-*. Deny unless the latest user prompt contains the word 'PROD-OK'. Track the latest prompt via prompt.submit.

mods.name: redactor
mods.description: Masks secrets and personal data in tool results before the model ever reads them.
mods.spec: Hook session.append for tool-result rows (door 'tool-result'): replace secrets (same patterns as secret-shield), emails, phone numbers, IBANs, credit cards (Luhn check), IPv4 private addresses optional, with [REDACTED:<kind>]. userConfig toggles per kind. .catch replaces content with a placeholder. Status line shows count redacted this session. Read reference.md section on session.append carefully.

mods.name: path-jail
mods.description: Allows writes only inside the project root, resolving symlinks and .. tricks.
mods.spec: tool.call guard on Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit and Bash commands with redirection (>, >>, tee, mv, cp, rm targets) : resolve target with $.fs.stat(path,{resolve:true}).realPath and allow only under project root realPath (+ userConfig extra roots, default includes /tmp). Deny otherwise. .catch denies.

mods.name: curl-pipe-guard
mods.description: Blocks piping downloaded scripts straight into a shell.
mods.spec: tool.call guard on Bash: detect curl|wget|iwr ... | (sh|bash|zsh|python|node|iex), bash <(curl ...), sh -c "$(curl ...)". Deny and suggest downloading, inspecting, then running.

mods.name: dependency-sentinel
mods.description: Flags typosquatted or brand-new packages before npm, pip or cargo installs them.
mods.spec: tool.call hook on Bash for npm/pnpm/yarn/bun add|install <pkgs>, pip install, cargo add, go get. For each package name: compare against embedded list of ~200 popular packages with Levenshtein distance 1-2 (typosquat), and query registry (registry.npmjs.org/<pkg>, pypi.org/pypi/<pkg>/json, crates.io api) via $.http.fetch: missing package, created < 30 days ago, or very few versions -> deny with details, unless prompt contains 'DEPS-OK'. Timeouts fail open with a toast.

mods.name: lockfile-guard
mods.description: Prevents hand-editing lockfiles; they must change through the package manager.
mods.spec: tool.call guard on Edit/Write/MultiEdit for package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, bun.lockb, Cargo.lock, poetry.lock, uv.lock, Gemfile.lock, composer.lock, go.sum. Deny with the right command to regenerate.

mods.name: git-status-line
mods.description: Shows the current branch, ahead/behind and dirty file count in the status line.
mods.spec: On session.start and after each tool.call that may change git state (Bash/Edit/Write), run `git status --porcelain=v2 --branch` via $.process.run, show e.g. '⎇ feat/x ↑2 ↓0 ●3'. Debounce with $.clock. Silent when not a repo.

mods.name: auto-checkpoint
mods.description: Snapshots your work tree before every editing turn and lets you /rollback to any checkpoint.
mods.spec: On first Edit/Write/Bash of a turn, create a snapshot without touching the index or branch: `git stash create` (or write-tree with a temp index) and store the commit under refs/claude-checkpoints/<n> via git update-ref. Keep last N (userConfig, default 20) in $.store with timestamp and the prompt text. /checkpoints lists them in a pane; /rewind <n> restores with confirmation (git checkout <sha> -- . after stashing current state). Silent outside git repos.

mods.name: commit-composer
mods.description: /commit writes a Conventional Commit message from your staged diff and commits it.
mods.spec: Register /commit. Read `git diff --cached` (if empty, offer to stage all via argument 'all'). Ask $.model.complete (small fast model, configurable) for a Conventional Commits message (type(scope): subject <=72 chars + body bullets). Show it in a Pane with Buttons Commit / Regenerate / Edit (Input) / Cancel. Commit via $.process.run(['git','commit','-m',msg]). Respect commitlint config if present.

mods.name: branch-namer
mods.description: /git-branch creates a well-named git branch from a short task description.
mods.spec: Register /branch <description>. Slugify the description into <type>/<kebab-slug> (type inferred from keywords: fix, feat, chore, docs, refactor, test; userConfig prefix e.g. initials). Run git switch -c. If no description, use the last user prompt (track via prompt.submit). Return text with the branch name.

mods.name: main-branch-warn
mods.description: Warns you the moment Claude starts editing files directly on main or master.
mods.spec: On first Edit/Write of a session while current branch is main/master/trunk (userConfig list), show a toast and status warning once; optional userConfig 'block' denies edits with suggestion to /branch.

mods.name: diff-pane
mods.description: A live pane listing changed files with +/- line counts, updated after every edit.
mods.spec: Command /diff opens a Pane; after each Edit/Write/Bash tool call refresh `git diff --numstat` + untracked files and store in $.state. Render a table: status glyph, path, +adds -dels bars (Raster or text bars), totals. Button per file to copy path; Button 'Show diff' renders Code format diff for the selected file.

mods.name: pr-describer
mods.description: /pr-desc drafts a pull request title and description from your branch diff.
mods.spec: Register /pr-desc [base]. Determine base (origin/HEAD or main). Collect git log base..HEAD and diff --stat plus truncated diff. $.model.complete to produce Title, Summary, Changes, Testing, Risks sections; honour .github/pull_request_template.md if present. Show in a Pane with Copy buttons ($.ui.copy) and 'Insert into prompt' ($.prompt.fill).

mods.name: conflict-helper
mods.description: Detects merge-conflict markers and walks you through resolving each one.
mods.spec: After git merge/rebase/pull Bash calls or on /conflicts, run git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U and grep for <<<<<<< markers. Pane lists files and hunk counts; per file buttons: 'Ask Claude to resolve' ($.prompt.submit with a precise instruction including both sides), 'Take ours', 'Take theirs' (git checkout --ours/--theirs). Also prompt.compose section reminding the model never to leave markers while conflicts exist. tool.call guard denies Write/Edit leaving <<<<<<< in content.

mods.name: co-author-stamp
mods.description: Adds configurable Co-authored-by trailers to commits Claude makes.
mods.spec: tool.call hook on Bash `git commit` with -m: append trailers from userConfig 'coAuthors' (comma separated 'Name <email>') if missing, via next({...e, command}). Also inspect the attribution event in the types and use it if appropriate.

mods.name: gitignore-guard
mods.description: Warns before node_modules, build output, OS junk or huge files get staged.
mods.spec: tool.call hook on Bash `git add`: for `git add -A/.`, run git status --porcelain to list what would be staged; deny if it includes node_modules/, dist/, build/, .DS_Store, *.log, .env, or files > 5MB (userConfig) that are not ignored, suggesting .gitignore lines.

mods.name: cost-meter
mods.description: Live session cost estimate in the status line, from real token usage.
mods.spec: On turn.complete read usage (input, output, cache read, cache creation) and model; price table per model family in code (per million tokens; userConfig override JSON). Accumulate in $.state, status '$0.42 · 128k tok'. /cost-reset command.

mods.name: token-budget
mods.description: Set a token or dollar budget per session; get warned at 80% and stopped at 100%.
mods.spec: userConfig budgetUsd and/or budgetTokens. Track usage from turn.complete. At 80% toast + band warning (AbovePrompt) with remaining budget; at 100% prompt.submit drop with message unless prompt starts with '!override'. /budget shows status and /budget set <n> changes it for the session ($.state).

mods.name: context-gauge
mods.description: A slim band above the prompt showing how full the context window is.
mods.spec: Read context usage from turn.complete usage (input + cache tokens vs model context window; inspect the types for a context breakdown API). AbovePrompt band with a 20-cell bar, percentage, colour green/yellow/red, hint '/compact' over 75%. Hide button.

mods.name: cache-hit-meter
mods.description: Shows what share of input tokens came from the prompt cache.
mods.spec: From turn.complete usage compute cache_read/(input+cache_read+cache_creation) per turn and for the session; status line 'cache 87%'. Toast once if session cache ratio drops under 30% after 5 turns.

mods.name: turn-timer
mods.description: Times every turn and tells you when one runs long.
mods.spec: prompt.submit records start ($.clock.now), turn.complete computes duration; status line 'last 34s · avg 21s'; toast when over userConfig threshold (default 120s).

mods.name: big-read-guard
mods.description: Stops full reads of huge files and nudges toward offset/limit or grep.
mods.spec: tool.call on Read without limit: $.fs.stat the file; if size > userConfig (default 256KB) or the file is a minified/bundled/lock file, deny with a message telling the model to use offset/limit or Grep. Allow if limit set.

mods.name: output-trimmer
mods.description: Trims huge command outputs to head, tail and error lines before they flood the context.
mods.spec: tool.call on Bash: await next(e); if result text exceeds userConfig maxChars (default 12000), return a rewritten result keeping first 60 lines, last 80 lines and every line matching error|fail|warn|exception|traceback (deduped, capped), with a note of how many lines were cut. Must respect ToolCallResult rules (study the types: returning a modified result for a built-in tool). Status shows tokens saved.

mods.name: daily-spend
mods.description: Tracks spend per day and week across sessions with a /spend report.
mods.spec: On turn.complete compute cost (price table like cost-meter) and add to $.store keyed by date and project. /spend opens a pane: today, this week, last 14 days sparkline (Raster on terminal, Text bars elsewhere), top projects. userConfig dailyLimit -> toast when exceeded.

mods.name: model-advisor
mods.description: Suggests a cheaper model when your prompt is simple, and a stronger one when it is hard.
mods.spec: On prompt.submit, classify prompt locally with heuristics (length, keywords like rename/typo/format vs architecture/debug/design) and optionally with $.model.complete on a haiku-class model (userConfig). Show a non-blocking toast/band hint like 'Simple task: /model haiku would do'. Never blocks or changes the model.

mods.name: compact-coach
mods.description: Suggests /compact at natural breakpoints, before the context gets tight.
mods.spec: Track context fill from turn.complete usage; when above 60% and the last turn ended a task (no pending todos, last tool was a commit or tests passed), toast 'Good moment to /compact'. At most once per 10 turns.

mods.name: quote-selection
mods.description: /quote pastes your mouse selection into the prompt as a Markdown quote.
mods.spec: Exactly the /quote example from reference.md, plus /quote-code which wraps it in a fenced code block.

mods.name: prompt-snippets
mods.description: Type :review:, :tests: or your own shortcodes and they expand into full prompts.
mods.spec: prompt.submit: replace :name: tokens with snippets from built-in defaults (review, tests, explain, refactor, docs, perf, security) merged with userConfig JSON map and $.store custom ones. /snippets list, /snippet-add name text.

mods.name: todo-pane
mods.description: A live pane of Claude's current task list with progress.
mods.spec: Hook tool.call for TodoWrite (inspect its input shape in the built-in tool types) and keep the latest todos in $.state. /todos opens a Pane: progress bar, items with ☐/◐/☑ by status. Auto-open from session.start only when viewport is wide (follow pane rules).

mods.name: focus-timer
mods.description: A Pomodoro timer in the status line with focus and break cycles.
mods.spec: /focus [minutes] starts, /focus stop, /focus status. $.clock.every(1000) updates status '🍅 18:42'. At end toast + optional sound; break timer follows. State in $.state; survives reload via $.store with end timestamp.

mods.name: scratchpad
mods.description: A persistent per-project notes pane you can type into without leaving Claude Code.
mods.spec: /notes opens a Pane with an Input to add a note, list of notes with delete Buttons and 'send to prompt' ($.prompt.fill). Stored in $.store keyed by project root. /note <text> adds quickly.

mods.name: recent-files
mods.description: /recent lists the files read and edited in this session, newest first.
mods.spec: Track file paths from Read/Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit tool calls into $.state (dedup, cap 50). /recent returns a text list with R/E markers and relative paths.

mods.name: copy-last
mods.description: /copy-last copies Claude's last answer (or its last code block) to the clipboard.
mods.spec: Use $.session.messages() to find the last assistant text. /copy-last copies all, /copy-code copies the last fenced code block. $.ui.copy and report result.

mods.name: prompt-history
mods.description: /history searches every prompt you have sent across sessions and reuses one.
mods.spec: prompt.submit stores prompt text with timestamp and project in $.store (cap 1000). /history opens a Pane with search Input and results; Button 'Use' fills the prompt via $.prompt.fill.

mods.name: quick-commands
mods.description: Short aliases like /t, /l and /b that run your test, lint and build commands.
mods.spec: Register /t /l /b /tc (typecheck) commands; each submits a prompt via $.prompt.submit like 'Run the test suite with <cmd> and fix failures' where cmd comes from userConfig or detection (package.json scripts, Makefile, pyproject, Cargo).

mods.name: idle-nudge
mods.description: Reminds you about uncommitted changes after a stretch of inactivity.
mods.spec: $.clock.every(60s): if no prompt for userConfig minutes (default 20) and git status shows changes, toast once 'You have N uncommitted files'. Reset on prompt.submit.

mods.name: auto-format
mods.description: Formats every file Claude edits with the right formatter for its language.
mods.spec: After Edit/Write/MultiEdit succeed (await next), detect formatter by extension and project config: prettier (js/ts/css/json/md if prettier in package.json or config), biome, black/ruff format (py), gofmt, rustfmt, shfmt, clang-format, php-cs-fixer. Run via $.process.run with timeout; on change, add context telling the model the file was reformatted. userConfig disable list.

mods.name: lint-on-save
mods.description: Runs the linter on each edited file and hands the errors straight back to Claude.
mods.spec: After edit tool calls succeed, run eslint/ruff/golangci-lint/clippy (detected) on the file, parse output, if errors return the result with context lines listing them (cap 30). Status shows lint error count.

mods.name: test-watch
mods.description: Runs the tests related to what changed and shows pass/fail in the status line.
mods.spec: After edits, debounce 3s with $.clock, map changed file to tests (same name .test/.spec/_test, tests/ mirror) and run detected runner (vitest/jest/pytest/go test/cargo test) only for those files. Status '✓ 12 passed' or '✗ 2 failed'. /tests-last shows the last output in a Pane.

mods.name: typecheck-gate
mods.description: Type-checks the project at the end of every editing turn so errors never slip by.
mods.spec: On turn.complete when the turn edited .ts/.tsx/.py files, run tsc --noEmit (or pyright/mypy) with timeout; if errors, $.session.append a user-role note with the first 20 errors or $.prompt.submit a follow-up asking to fix (userConfig mode 'notify'|'autofix', default notify toast + status).

mods.name: no-skip-tests
mods.description: Blocks Claude from silencing tests with .skip, .only, xit or skip markers.
mods.spec: tool.call guard on Edit/Write/MultiEdit for test files: deny when new content adds it.skip/describe.skip/test.only/fit/xit/xdescribe/@pytest.mark.skip/@unittest.skip/t.Skip(/#[ignore] that were not in old content.

mods.name: todo-tracker
mods.description: Notices every TODO, FIXME and HACK Claude adds and lists them at turn end.
mods.spec: Track added TODO|FIXME|HACK|XXX lines from Edit/Write new content in a turn; on turn.complete toast count and /todos-added lists file:line items.

mods.name: debug-catcher
mods.description: Warns when console.log, print, debugger or dbg! statements are left in code.
mods.spec: After edits to source files (not tests/scripts), detect added console.log/debugger/print(/pp/var_dump/dbg!/fmt.Println debug patterns; add context note to the result asking to remove them before finishing, and status count.

mods.name: no-any
mods.description: Flags new any types, @ts-ignore and eslint-disable comments as Claude writes them.
mods.spec: Edit/Write hook on ts/tsx: count added ': any', 'as any', '<any>', @ts-ignore, @ts-nocheck, eslint-disable. userConfig mode warn (context note) or block (deny).

mods.name: file-size-watch
mods.description: Warns when an edited file grows past a size that hurts readability.
mods.spec: After edits, count lines of the file via $.fs.read; if > userConfig (default 500) and grew this edit, add context suggesting splitting it, toast once per file.

mods.name: test-first
mods.description: A TDD mode: no production code changes until a test has been written or changed.
mods.spec: /tdd on|off. When on, per turn track if a test file was edited; deny Edit/Write on non-test source files until then, with message explaining TDD flow. Band shows 'TDD: red → green → refactor' phase guess based on last test run result (Bash test command exit status).

mods.name: tool-timeline
mods.description: A timeline pane of every tool call with duration, status and input summary.
mods.spec: Record each tool.call start/end ($.clock.now) with tool, short summary of input (command, path, pattern), isError. /timeline opens Pane with rows and duration bars, scrolling to latest. Keep 300.

mods.name: files-touched
mods.description: A pane of every file read, edited or created in the session, with counts.
mods.spec: Track per file reads/edits/creates. /files opens Pane grouped by directory with counts and Buttons to copy path or insert @path into prompt.

mods.name: session-stats
mods.description: /session-stats shows a dashboard of turns, tools, tokens, cost, duration and files.
mods.spec: Aggregate from prompt.submit, tool.call, turn.complete. /stats Pane with tiles (turns, tool calls by type top 5, tokens in/out/cache, est cost, wall time, files edited), tool histogram as text bars.

mods.name: subagent-monitor
mods.description: Watch running subagents live: type, status, duration and last activity.
mods.spec: Use $.agent.list() polled with $.clock.every(2000) while the pane is open, and agent-related events (inspect types). /agents-live opens Pane listing agents with status, runtime, description.

mods.name: error-feed
mods.description: Collects every failed command and tool error in one pane.
mods.spec: On tool.call results with isError or Bash non-zero, store tool, summary, first 300 chars of error, time. /errors Pane with list and Button 'Ask Claude to fix' ($.prompt.submit with error). Status '⚠ 3 errors'.

mods.name: activity-heatmap
mods.description: A heat map of when you use Claude Code, by hour and weekday.
mods.spec: Record prompt counts per weekday×hour in $.store. /heatmap Pane draws 7×24 Raster heat map on terminal (Text grid elsewhere) with legend and totals.

mods.name: bash-history
mods.description: /bash-history lists recent shell commands Claude ran, with exit status and duration.
mods.spec: Record Bash tool calls (command, ok/error, duration). /bash-history returns the last 30 as text.

mods.name: web-trail
mods.description: /sources lists every page Claude fetched or searched this session.
mods.spec: Record WebFetch urls and WebSearch queries. /sources returns them as a Markdown list with timestamps.

mods.name: permission-log
mods.description: Keeps a log of every tool call that was denied, and why.
mods.spec: await next on every tool.call; if result.deny record tool, summary, reason. /denied lists them. Status shows count.

mods.name: token-sparkline
mods.description: A sparkline of tokens per turn right above the prompt.
mods.spec: On turn.complete push total tokens to $.state (last 40). AbovePrompt band: Raster sparkline on terminal, unicode ▁▂▃▅▇ Text on other surfaces, plus last and max values. Hide button.

mods.name: house-style
mods.description: Injects your team's style guide (STYLE.md) into the system prompt automatically.
mods.spec: prompt.compose: read STYLE.md / .claude/style.md / CONTRIBUTING.md style section from project root via $.fs (cache by mtime), add a section 'Project house style' (scope session). Cap length. /style shows what is injected.

mods.name: language-lock
mods.description: Makes Claude always answer in your language while keeping code in English.
mods.spec: userConfig language (default 'English'). prompt.compose adds a section: answer in <language>; keep code, identifiers and commit messages in English unless asked.

mods.name: concise-mode
mods.description: /concise toggles short, to-the-point answers.
mods.spec: /concise toggles $.state flag; prompt.compose adds brevity instruction when on; status shows 'concise'.

mods.name: prompt-enhancer
mods.description: /enhance rewrites your draft prompt into a precise, well-scoped request.
mods.spec: /enhance <draft>: $.model.complete with a rewriting system prompt including project context (stack detected from files) -> show original vs enhanced in a Pane with Buttons 'Use' ($.prompt.fill replace) and 'Send' ($.prompt.submit).

mods.name: ticket-linker
mods.description: Turns ticket references like ABC-123 or #42 into links and context for Claude.
mods.spec: prompt.submit: detect JIRA-style keys and #123; using userConfig jiraBaseUrl and GitHub repo from git remote, append a 'Referenced tickets' line with URLs to the prompt text.

mods.name: date-context
mods.description: Gives Claude the current date, time zone, branch and OS on every prompt.
mods.spec: prompt.compose adds a short section with ISO date/time ($.clock.now), time zone (Intl), current git branch and platform. Keep tiny.

mods.name: persona-switch
mods.description: /persona switches Claude between reviewer, architect, teacher and other roles.
mods.spec: Built-in personas (reviewer, architect, teacher, pair-programmer, security-auditor, product-minded) plus userConfig custom JSON. /persona <name>|off, /personas lists. prompt.compose section; band or status shows active persona; persisted per project in $.store.

mods.name: explain-level
mods.description: /eli5, /normal and /expert set how deep Claude's explanations go.
mods.spec: Commands set level in $.state; prompt.compose adds corresponding instruction; status shows level when not normal.

mods.name: stack-detector
mods.description: Detects your stack and gives Claude the right conventions for it.
mods.spec: On session.start scan root files (package.json deps: react/next/vue/svelte/express/nest; pyproject/requirements: django/fastapi/flask; go.mod; Cargo.toml; Gemfile/rails; composer laravel; pom/gradle spring; Dockerfile; terraform). prompt.compose adds concise conventions per detected tech (embedded short guides). /stack shows detection.

mods.name: prompt-lint
mods.description: Gently flags vague prompts like 'fix it' and suggests what to add.
mods.spec: prompt.submit: heuristics (very short, only pronouns, no file/target, 'fix it', 'doesn't work'); show toast with a tip; never blocks unless userConfig strict, where it drops with tips. Skip slash commands.

mods.name: done-chime
mods.description: Plays a chime when a long turn finishes.
mods.spec: On turn.complete if duration > userConfig seconds (default 20) $.audio.play a bundled short wav asset (generate a tiny valid WAV file programmatically and commit it in assets/). Inspect $.audio types for asset paths.

mods.name: speak-summary
mods.description: Reads a one-line summary of what Claude did out loud when a turn ends.
mods.spec: On turn.complete (duration > threshold), take the last assistant text, $.model.complete a <=15 word spoken summary with a small model, $.audio.speak it. /speak on|off toggle; userConfig voice/rate if available.

mods.name: permission-ping
mods.description: Pings you with a sound and toast when Claude is waiting on your approval.
mods.spec: Find the event raised when a permission dialog appears (inspect types: tool.check, classic.Notification, ui.render of the permission dialog component). Play sound + toast once per request.

mods.name: error-buzz
mods.description: A short buzz when a command or test run fails.
mods.spec: After Bash tool call with isError or test-runner commands failing, $.audio.play a bundled wav (generate tiny WAV). Rate-limit to one per 10s.

mods.name: webhook-notify
mods.description: Posts to Slack, Discord, Teams or ntfy when a long task finishes.
mods.spec: userConfig webhookUrl (secret), kind (slack|discord|ntfy|generic), minDurationSec. On turn.complete over threshold POST with $.http.fetch formatted payload: project, duration, short summary (first 200 chars of last assistant text), tool counts. /notify-test.

mods.name: desktop-notify
mods.description: Native desktop notifications when Claude finishes or needs you.
mods.spec: On turn.complete over threshold run osascript (macOS), notify-send (Linux) or powershell toast (Windows) via $.process.run, detecting platform via $.env/ process. Fail silently.

mods.name: long-run-alert
mods.description: Alerts you when a single command has been running too long.
mods.spec: On Bash tool.call start a $.clock.after(userConfig seconds, default 60) timer that toasts 'still running: <cmd>'; cancel when next resolves.

mods.name: ci-watch
mods.description: /ci-watch follows your GitHub Actions run and tells you the moment it passes or fails.
mods.spec: /ci-watch [branch]: poll `gh run list --branch <b> --limit 1 --json status,conclusion,name,url` every 30s with $.clock.every via $.process.run; status '⏳ CI running'; on completion toast + sound + optional $.prompt.submit 'CI failed: investigate' if userConfig autoFix. /ci-watch stop.

mods.name: break-reminder
mods.description: Reminds you to stand up and stretch every 50 minutes of active work.
mods.spec: Track active time (prompts within last 5 min count as active); every userConfig minutes (default 50) toast a rotating friendly reminder.

mods.name: celebrate
mods.description: Celebrates when failing tests go green again.
mods.spec: Track test-runner Bash calls (jest/vitest/pytest/go test/cargo test/npm test); when a previously failing run now succeeds, toast '🎉 All green' and play a bundled sound (generate tiny WAV).

mods.name: decision-log
mods.description: /decide records an Architecture Decision Record in docs/decisions.
mods.spec: /decide <title>: $.model.fork to draft an ADR (Context, Decision, Consequences, Alternatives) from the conversation; preview in Pane; Save writes docs/decisions/NNNN-slug.md via $.fs (next number). /decisions lists existing ADR titles.

mods.name: session-journal
mods.description: Writes a dated journal entry of what was done when the session ends.
mods.spec: On session.end (not for 'clear' unless userConfig) use $.model.fork to summarise work done, files changed, open questions; append to .claude/journal/YYYY-MM-DD.md. /journal writes one now.

mods.name: glossary
mods.description: Teaches Claude your project's vocabulary and injects definitions when you use the terms.
mods.spec: Load GLOSSARY.md or .claude/glossary.json plus $.store entries. /define term = meaning adds. On prompt.submit detect terms (case-insensitive word match) and add a context note with their definitions (use prompt.submit's context if available, else prompt.compose session section).

mods.name: bookmark
mods.description: /bookmark saves the last answer; /bookmarks lists and reuses them.
mods.spec: /bookmark [label] stores last assistant text (first 2000 chars) with label/time in $.store per project; /bookmarks lists; /bookmark-insert <n> fills prompt.

mods.name: resume-brief
mods.description: Shows what you were working on last time when a new session starts.
mods.spec: On session.end store a brief (last prompts, files edited, branch, todos) in $.store per project; on session.start show it in a toast/AbovePrompt band with Button 'Continue' that submits 'Continue where we left off: ...'.

mods.name: lessons-learned
mods.description: When Claude fixes a mistake, offers to save the lesson to CLAUDE.md.
mods.spec: Detect fix cycles: a Bash test/build failure followed later by success after edits. On turn.complete in that case, $.model.complete a one-line lesson and show band with Buttons 'Save to CLAUDE.md' (append under '## Lessons learned' via $.fs) / 'Dismiss'.

mods.name: codebase-map
mods.description: /map builds a compact map of your repository and gives it to Claude.
mods.spec: /map: list files via `git ls-files` (fallback $.fs.list recursion with ignores), build a tree with dir counts and key files (entry points, configs), cap size; store in .claude/codebase-map.md and add as prompt.compose section when userConfig autoInject is on. Pane to view.

mods.name: snippet-vault
mods.description: Save and reuse code snippets across projects with /save-snippet and /snippet.
mods.spec: /save-snippet <name> saves the last fenced code block from assistant output (or $.ui.selection) to $.store; /snippet <name> fills prompt with it; /snippets lists.

mods.name: link-vault
mods.description: Collects every URL from the conversation into one list.
mods.spec: Scan prompts and assistant messages (via session.append or $.session.messages on demand) for URLs; /links lists unique ones with source; /links-copy copies all.

mods.name: recall
mods.description: Gives Claude a recall tool to search your saved notes, decisions and journal.
mods.spec: $.tool.register a tool 'search' (listed mcp__recall__search) with input {query}. Search across .claude/journal, docs/decisions, CLAUDE.md, scratchpad/bookmark stores in $.store if accessible (only own store), returning top matches with simple BM25-ish scoring. Also /remember <text> to add memories to its own store.

mods.name: changelog-keeper
mods.description: Keeps CHANGELOG.md's Unreleased section up to date as you commit.
mods.spec: After a successful git commit Bash call, parse the commit subject (Conventional Commits) and add a bullet under ## [Unreleased] in the right Keep a Changelog subsection (Added/Changed/Fixed/...) via $.fs; create the file if missing (userConfig). /changelog shows Unreleased.

mods.name: readme-sync
mods.description: Warns when public APIs, CLI flags or env vars change but the docs do not.
mods.spec: Track edits within the turn: exported symbols changes in src (regex on export lines), CLI option definitions, process.env/os.environ names. On turn.complete if such changes and no README/docs edits, band with 'Ask Claude to update docs' Button ($.prompt.submit).

mods.name: standup
mods.description: /standup summarises what you did yesterday, from git history, ready to paste.
mods.spec: /standup [days]: git log --author=<git config user.email> --since, plus journal if present; $.model.complete into Yesterday / Today / Blockers bullets; Pane with Copy button.

mods.name: review-agent
mods.description: Adds a dedicated code-reviewer subagent and a /review command.
mods.spec: $.agent.register a 'reviewer' agent type (read-only tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash for git diff) with a strong review prompt (correctness, security, tests, readability, severity labels). /review [base] spawns it via $.agent.spawn on the current diff and shows findings in a Pane.

mods.name: license-header
mods.description: Adds your license header to every new source file Claude creates.
mods.spec: tool.call on Write for new files (check $.fs.stat not exists) with source extensions: prepend header from userConfig (default SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT line, plus copyright holder and year) in the right comment syntax, via next({...e, content}).

mods.name: issue-drafter
mods.description: /issue turns the current conversation into a well-structured GitHub issue.
mods.spec: /issue [bug|feature]: $.model.fork to draft title + body (Summary, Steps/Proposal, Expected, Actual, Context). Pane preview with 'Create with gh' Button (gh issue create --title --body-file via temp file in /tmp written with $.fs) and Copy.

mods.name: handoff
mods.description: /handoff writes a handoff note so a teammate can pick up exactly where you left off.
mods.spec: /handoff: $.model.fork for Goal, Status, What changed (files), Next steps, Gotchas, How to verify; write .claude/handoff/YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM.md and copy to clipboard.

mods.name: i18n-guard
mods.description: Flags hard-coded user-facing strings in UI components.
mods.spec: Edit/Write hook on .jsx/.tsx/.vue/.svelte: detect added JSX text nodes or string literal props (title, placeholder, aria-label, alt) with letters that are not wrapped in t()/i18n calls; add context note listing them (warn mode) or deny (block mode, userConfig).

mods.name: migration-guard
mods.description: Prevents editing database migrations that already exist; write a new one instead.
mods.spec: Edit/MultiEdit/Write on existing files under migrations/, db/migrate/, prisma/migrations/, alembic/versions/, supabase/migrations/: deny if the file existed at session start or is tracked in git (git ls-files). New files allowed.

mods.name: codeowners-hint
mods.description: Shows who owns a file (from CODEOWNERS) as Claude edits it.
mods.spec: Parse CODEOWNERS (root, .github/, docs/) with gitignore-style patterns, last match wins. On Edit/Write show status 'owners: @team-x' for the file, and /owners <path>.

mods.name: react-doctor
mods.description: Catches React hook mistakes as Claude writes them: missing effect deps, setState in render, conditional hooks.
mods.spec: After Edit/Write on .jsx/.tsx: lightweight parse (regex + brace matching) of changed components: hooks called conditionally or in loops, useEffect/useMemo/useCallback dependency arrays missing identifiers used inside, setState called at render top level, missing key in .map JSX. Add context note listing issues (file:line). If eslint-plugin-react-hooks is installed, prefer running eslint on the file and parsing results.

mods.name: next-guard
mods.description: Flags missing or needless "use client" and server-only imports leaking into client components in Next.js.
mods.spec: Only when package.json has next. After Edit/Write in app/ or src/app: component using useState/useEffect/onClick/browser APIs without 'use client' -> note; file with 'use client' importing server-only modules (fs, server-only, next/headers, db clients) -> note; 'use client' in a file with no client features -> hint.

mods.name: venv-guard
mods.description: Blocks pip install outside an active virtualenv so system Python stays clean.
mods.spec: tool.call on Bash: pip/pip3/python -m pip install (not with --user? still block) when no VIRTUAL_ENV in env, no .venv/venv in project activated in the command (e.g. `source .venv/bin/activate &&`, `.venv/bin/pip`), and not uv/poetry/pipx. Deny with how to create/activate a venv or use uv. userConfig allowGlobal.

mods.name: node-version-check
mods.description: Warns when your Node version doesn't match .nvmrc, .node-version or package.json engines.
mods.spec: At session.start (and before npm/pnpm/yarn install commands) run `node --version`, compare with .nvmrc/.node-version/.tool-versions/engines.node semver range (implement a small semver range check for ^, ~, >=, x). Toast + status warning once; context note on install commands.

mods.name: django-migrate-watch
mods.description: After Django model changes, checks for missing migrations and offers to create them.
mods.spec: Only in Django projects (manage.py). After edits to */models.py or models/ package, debounce, run `python manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run` (with project venv python if found) and if changes pending, band with 'Create migrations' button ($.prompt.submit asking to run makemigrations and review) and status. Timeout + silent on errors.

mods.name: go-mod-tidy
mods.description: Runs go mod tidy when Claude changes Go imports, so go.mod and go.sum stay in sync.
mods.spec: After Edit/Write on .go files where the import block changed (compare old/new import sets), debounce 2s and run `go mod tidy` in the module root (nearest go.mod) with timeout; toast result; context note if it changed go.mod.

mods.name: strict-types
mods.description: Adds declare(strict_types=1) to new PHP files and from __future__ import annotations to new Python files.
mods.spec: tool.call on Write for new files: .php -> insert declare(strict_types=1); after <?php opening line if missing; .py -> insert `from __future__ import annotations` after module docstring/shebang/encoding if missing (userConfig python on/off, default off for py>=3.14? default on). Rewrite via next({...e, content}).

mods.name: schema-sync
mods.description: After Prisma or Drizzle schema edits, regenerates the client and warns when a migration is missing.
mods.spec: Detect prisma/schema.prisma or drizzle config. After edits to the schema: run `npx prisma generate` (or drizzle-kit generate --check style) with timeout; then check migration status (`prisma migrate diff --from-migrations prisma/migrations --to-schema-datamodel ... --exit-code` or `prisma migrate status`) and show band 'Schema changed without migration' with button to ask Claude to create one.

mods.name: env-example-sync
mods.description: Keeps .env.example in sync with the environment variables your code actually reads.
mods.spec: After Edit/Write on source files, detect newly added env var reads (process.env.X, import.meta.env.X, os.environ['X'], os.getenv('X'), env('X'), ENV['X'], os.Getenv("X")). If .env.example (or .env.sample) exists and lacks X, append `X=` with a comment `# added by env-example-sync`. Toast. userConfig file name, ignore list. Never touch .env.

mods.name: monorepo-scope
mods.description: Detects which monorepo package you're in and scopes test, lint and build commands to it.
mods.spec: Detect workspaces (pnpm-workspace.yaml, package.json workspaces, turbo.json, nx.json, lerna). Track the package of the most recently edited files. Status shows '📦 @app/web'. tool.call on Bash: rewrite root-level `pnpm test`/`npm test`/`turbo run test`/`nx test` into filtered versions (`pnpm --filter <pkg> test`, `turbo run test --filter=<pkg>`, `nx test <project>`) when userConfig autoScope is on; otherwise add a context hint. /scope-pkg shows/sets package.

mods.name: docker-lint
mods.description: Flags Dockerfile smells: :latest tags, running as root, apt without cleanup, ADD instead of COPY.
mods.spec: After Edit/Write on Dockerfile*/*.dockerfile: rules: FROM x:latest or no tag; no USER (non-root) instruction; apt-get install without --no-install-recommends or without rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists; ADD for local files; curl|sh; secrets in ENV/ARG names; multiple RUN apt-get update separate from install. If hadolint is installed run it instead/also. Context note list.

mods.name: k8s-dry-run
mods.description: Turns kubectl apply into a server-side dry run with a diff you approve first.
mods.spec: tool.call on Bash kubectl apply/replace/delete (not already --dry-run): first run `kubectl diff -f ...` (same args) via $.process.run, show diff summary in a Pane (Code diff), deny the original call with a message containing the diff summary and instructions: re-run with the same command after the user confirms, OR user presses 'Approve' in pane which stores an approval token for that exact command (one-time) so the next identical call passes. Fail closed for prod contexts (reuse simple prod regex) and open otherwise.

mods.name: terraform-plan-pane
mods.description: Shows terraform plan as a clear pane of resources to create, change and destroy.
mods.spec: After Bash `terraform plan` (or tofu) completes: run `terraform show -json <planfile>` if -out used, else parse plan text output (lines '# x will be created/updated/destroyed/replaced', summary 'Plan: a to add, b to change, c to destroy'). Pane /tfplan with grouped lists, destroy in red, counts header. Toast if anything will be destroyed.

mods.name: ci-yaml-check
mods.description: Checks edited GitHub Actions workflows and warns about actions not pinned to a version.
mods.spec: After Edit/Write on .github/workflows/*.yml: run actionlint if available; else built-in checks: `uses:` without @ref or @main/@master (warn; suggest SHA pin), missing `permissions:` block, `pull_request_target` with checkout of PR head, secrets echoed. YAML parse basic (indentation tabs). Context note.

mods.name: port-check
mods.description: Before a dev server starts, tells you if the port is already taken and by which process.
mods.spec: tool.call on Bash commands that start servers (npm run dev/start, vite, next dev, rails s, python manage.py runserver, flask run, uvicorn, php artisan serve, --port N): determine port (flag or default per tool), check with `lsof -nP -iTCP:<port> -sTCP:LISTEN` (or `ss -ltnp`) and if in use add a context note + toast naming the process (pid, command). Do not block.

mods.name: dev-server-pane
mods.description: Starts your dev server in the background and shows its errors in a live pane.
mods.spec: /dev [command]: detect dev command (package.json dev/start, manage.py runserver, rails s, etc.), start via $.process.spawn (streaming) keeping a ring buffer of the last 500 lines; Pane shows status (running/exited, port detected from output URL), last lines with errors highlighted, Buttons Restart / Stop / 'Ask Claude to fix' (submit last error block). /dev stop. Stop on session.end.

mods.name: cloud-cost-warn
mods.description: Warns before commands that create expensive cloud resources like GPU instances or large databases.
mods.spec: tool.call on Bash: aws ec2 run-instances with instance types p*/g*/x*/*.metal or large sizes (>= 8xlarge), aws rds create-db-instance, gcloud compute instances create with --accelerator or large machine types, az vm create with N-series, eksctl/gcloud container clusters create. Deny once with estimated hourly cost range (embedded rough table) unless prompt contains 'COST-OK'.

mods.name: log-tail
mods.description: /tail follows a log file or container in a live pane, with an errors-only filter.
mods.spec: /tail <path|docker:container|compose:service>: spawn `tail -n 200 -F path` or `docker logs -f --tail 200 x` via $.process.spawn; ring buffer 1000 lines; Pane with filter Input (substring/regex), 'Errors only' toggle, pause/resume, 'Send selection to Claude'. /tail stop. Multiple tails by id.

mods.name: docker-prune-guard
mods.description: Blocks docker system prune -a --volumes and volume deletion that can wipe local databases.
mods.spec: tool.call on Bash: docker system prune with --volumes or -a, docker volume prune/rm, docker compose down -v / --volumes, podman equivalents. Deny with what would be lost and safer alternative; allow if prompt has 'PRUNE-OK'.

mods.name: deploy-checklist
mods.description: Shows a pre-deploy checklist (tests, branch, changelog) and asks you to confirm before deploying.
mods.spec: tool.call on Bash deploy commands (vercel --prod, netlify deploy --prod, fly deploy, firebase deploy, gcloud app deploy, kubectl rollout, cap production deploy, npm publish, userConfig extra regex). Gather: current branch (must be main/master or userConfig), uncommitted changes, last test run result in session, CHANGELOG touched. Deny with checklist and open a Pane with Buttons 'Deploy anyway' (one-time approval for that exact command) / Cancel. .catch fails closed.

mods.name: sql-safety
mods.description: Flags UPDATE and DELETE without WHERE in .sql files and in queries inside your code.
mods.spec: After Edit/Write: scan added SQL in .sql files and string literals/template literals containing SQL in code: UPDATE ... SET without WHERE, DELETE FROM without WHERE, DROP TABLE/DATABASE, TRUNCATE. userConfig mode warn (context note) or block (deny). Ignore migrations directories for DROP (configurable).

mods.name: query-explain
mods.description: /explain-query runs EXPLAIN on your local database and explains the plan in plain words.
mods.spec: /explain-query <sql> (or selection): detect local DB from DATABASE_URL in .env (only localhost/127.0.0.1/sqlite files; refuse others) and run EXPLAIN (ANALYZE only if userConfig and query is SELECT) via psql/mysql/sqlite3 CLI. Then $.model.complete to summarise bottlenecks (seq scans, missing indexes) with index suggestions. Pane with raw plan (Code) and explanation.

mods.name: seed-guard
mods.description: Blocks database seed, reset and drop commands unless DATABASE_URL points at your own machine.
mods.spec: tool.call on Bash: prisma migrate reset, prisma db push --force-reset, rails db:reset/db:drop/db:seed, php artisan migrate:fresh/db:seed, django flush, knex seed:run, sequelize db:seed, npm run seed/db:reset. Read DATABASE_URL from command env prefix, process env ($.env) or .env file; allow only localhost/127.0.0.1/::1/sqlite/docker service names in userConfig allowHosts. Deny otherwise. .catch fails closed.

mods.name: schema-pane
mods.description: A pane of your local database's tables and columns, ready to hand to Claude as context.
mods.spec: /schema: connect via CLI to local DB (DATABASE_URL in .env, local only) and list tables, columns, types, PK/FK, indexes (information_schema for postgres/mysql, sqlite_master+pragma for sqlite). Pane with expandable tables and a Button 'Send to Claude' (prompt.fill compact schema text) and 'Inject in context' toggle (prompt.compose session section, capped).

mods.name: n-plus-one-hint
mods.description: Spots database queries inside loops, the classic N+1 problem, as Claude writes them.
mods.spec: After edits: heuristic per language: inside for/forEach/map/while bodies (brace or indentation tracking) detect await prisma.x.find*, .objects.get/filter, Model.find/where, db.query, .findOne, repository.find, session.query. Context note with file:line and suggestion (include/select_related/batching).

mods.name: migration-namer
mods.description: Gives new migrations consistent, descriptive, timestamped names.
mods.spec: tool.call on Write of a new file in a migrations directory: if name lacks timestamp or is generic (migration.sql, new, temp, update), deny with a suggested name following the directory's existing convention (detect pattern from sibling files: 0001_x.py, 20240101120000_x.sql, YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_x.rb). Also /migration-name <description> returns a name.

mods.name: query-result-cap
mods.description: Adds a LIMIT to ad-hoc SELECTs Claude runs in psql, mysql or sqlite so results don't flood the context.
mods.spec: tool.call on Bash psql -c/-command, mysql -e, sqlite3 '...': if the SQL is a SELECT without LIMIT/TOP/FETCH FIRST and without aggregate-only, rewrite to append LIMIT <userConfig default 50> via next({...e, command}); add context note. Handle quoting carefully; if unsure, leave untouched.

mods.name: backup-before-migrate
mods.description: Dumps your local database before every migration so a bad one is one command away from undo.
mods.spec: tool.call on Bash migration commands (prisma migrate dev/deploy, rails db:migrate, alembic upgrade, django migrate, knex migrate:latest, php artisan migrate, goose up, flyway migrate): for local DBs only, first run pg_dump/mysqldump/sqlite3 .backup into .claude/db-backups/<timestamp>.sql(.gz) (keep last N), then run the migration. /db-backups lists, /db-restore <n> prints the exact restore command (does not run it automatically). Skip with toast if dump tool missing.

mods.name: csv-peek
mods.description: /peek shows a CSV or JSONL file's columns, sample rows and inferred types without reading the whole file.
mods.spec: /peek <path> [rows]: read first ~64KB via $.fs (bytes range if possible) and count lines cheaply via `wc -l`; parse CSV (quotes, delimiter sniffing , ; \t |) or JSONL; infer types per column (int, float, bool, date, string, empty%). Return Markdown table of columns + first 5 rows. Also tool.call on Read of .csv > 1MB without limit: deny suggesting /peek.

mods.name: fixture-factory
mods.description: /fixtures generates realistic test data that matches your schema or types.
mods.spec: /fixtures <model|type|table> [count]: locate definition (Prisma model, TS interface/type, Pydantic/dataclass, Django model, SQL CREATE TABLE) via grep in project; $.model.complete to produce N realistic records respecting types/constraints/relations as JSON; validate JSON; Pane preview with Save (writes fixtures/<name>.json or tests/fixtures) and Insert into prompt.

mods.name: a11y-guard
mods.description: Flags accessibility misses as Claude writes UI: images without alt, unlabeled buttons, clickable divs.
mods.spec: After Edit/Write on jsx/tsx/vue/svelte/html: added without alt,

mods.name: screenshot-check
mods.description: After UI edits, takes a Playwright screenshot of the page and shows it to Claude.
mods.spec: /screenshot [url] and optional auto mode after UI file edits (debounced): detect running dev server URL (port-check style or userConfig baseUrl); run a small Playwright script via $.process.run (node -e with playwright if installed in project, else npx playwright screenshot) at desktop and mobile widths, save to .claude/screenshots/. Attach to the conversation: use $.prompt.submit with attachments if API supports images (inspect types for attachments/image), else tell the model the file path to Read. Pane shows Image on terminal where supported.

mods.name: bundle-size-watch
mods.description: Compares bundle size after each build and warns when it grows.
mods.spec: After Bash build commands (npm run build, vite build, next build, webpack): measure total and per-file sizes of output dir (dist/, build/, .next/static) via `du`/fs listing (gzip estimate optional via `gzip -c | wc -c` for top 10 files), store last in $.store per project; status '📦 412 KB (+18 KB)'; toast if growth > userConfig % (default 5).

mods.name: css-token-guard
mods.description: Flags hard-coded hex colors and pixel values where your design tokens should be used.
mods.spec: Only if the project has tokens (CSS custom properties in a tokens/variables file, tailwind config theme, theme.ts). After edits to css/scss/jsx/tsx: added literal #hex/rgb()/hsl() colors (and optional px spacing) not in allowlist -> context note suggesting the closest existing token by color distance (parse var definitions for hex values).

mods.name: lighthouse-run
mods.description: /lighthouse runs Lighthouse on a URL and shows performance, a11y, SEO and best-practice scores in a pane.
mods.spec: /lighthouse <url> [mobile|desktop]: run `npx lighthouse <url> --output=json --quiet --chrome-flags="--headless"` with timeout (detect CHROME_PATH / playwright chromium); parse categories and top 5 failing audits with savings. Pane: score tiles colored, audits list, Button 'Ask Claude to fix top issues'. Store last result for comparison and show deltas.

mods.name: heavy-asset-warn
mods.description: Warns when large images, videos or fonts are added to the project.
mods.spec: After Write or Bash commands that add files (cp/mv/curl -o/wget into public/, assets/, static/, src/): stat new files; image > 300KB, video > 2MB, font > 200KB (userConfig) -> toast + context note suggesting compression/format (webp/avif, woff2). Also on git add of such files.

mods.name: storybook-nudge
mods.description: Reminds you to add a story when Claude creates a new component without one.
mods.spec: Only if .storybook/ exists. After Write of a new component file (PascalCase .tsx/.jsx/.vue/.svelte under components/), check for sibling *.stories.* ; if absent, at turn.complete toast and band Button 'Ask Claude to add stories' ($.prompt.submit).

mods.name: contrast-checker
mods.description: Checks that the colors Claude changes in CSS meet WCAG AA contrast.
mods.spec: After CSS/SCSS/styled/tailwind edits: extract color/background-color pairs within the same rule block (and CSS variables resolved from :root and dark theme blocks); compute WCAG contrast ratio (implement relative luminance), flag < 4.5 (normal text) / < 3 (large text if font-size >= 24px or bold >= 18.66px). Context note with ratio and a suggested adjusted color that passes (lighten/darken in HSL until passing).

mods.name: dark-mode-check
mods.description: Flags colors added without a dark-mode variant in projects that support a dark theme.
mods.spec: Detect dark mode support (prefers-color-scheme in CSS, tailwind darkMode, [data-theme=dark]). After edits: tailwind classes like bg-white/text-gray-900 added without dark: counterpart on the same element; CSS color literals in rules not overridden in a dark block. Context note.

mods.name: component-catalog
mods.description: /components lists your existing UI components so Claude reuses them instead of creating duplicates.
mods.spec: Scan component dirs (components/, src/components, ui/, app/components; configurable) for exported components with props (parse export function X({ a, b }: Props) / interface XProps). /components Pane with searchable list and props. prompt.compose section (session scope, capped ~3k chars) listing names + one-line purpose (from JSDoc or first comment). Before Write of a new component whose name is similar (Levenshtein) to an existing one, add context note.

mods.name: http-client
mods.description: /http sends a request and shows the formatted response in a pane, like a tiny Postman in your terminal.
mods.spec: /http <METHOD> <url> [json body] [-H 'K: V']: $.http.fetch with timeout; Pane shows status, time, headers (collapsible), body pretty-printed (JSON/Markdown/Code). Buttons: Copy as curl, Send to Claude, Repeat. History of last 20 in $.store; /http history. Refuse to send headers named Authorization to non-https unless localhost.

mods.name: openapi-sync
mods.description: Warns when your API routes change but openapi.yaml doesn't.
mods.spec: Detect spec file (openapi.yaml/json, swagger.*). Track edits to route definitions (express app.get/router.post, fastify, Next route handlers app/**/route.ts, FastAPI @app.get, Flask @route, Django urls.py, Laravel routes/*.php, Go mux HandleFunc). At turn.complete, if routes added/removed/changed paths not present in spec and spec not edited, band listing them with 'Ask Claude to update the spec'.

mods.name: url-allowlist
mods.description: Restricts WebFetch to the domains you allow.
mods.spec: tool.call guard on WebFetch (and optionally curl/wget in Bash): userConfig allowlist (default: docs domains like developer.mozilla.org, docs.python.org, github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com, npmjs.com, pypi.org, stackoverflow.com, docs.anthropic.com... ) and mode allow|block-list. Deny other hosts with message; /allow-host <host> adds for the session.

mods.name: offline-mode
mods.description: /offline blocks every network call — fetches, curl, installs, git push — until you turn it back on.
mods.spec: /offline on|off toggles $.state flag; status '✈ offline'. When on: deny WebFetch, WebSearch, Bash with curl/wget/http/npm|pnpm|yarn|pip install/git push|pull|fetch|clone/ssh/scp/docker pull; $.http fetches by this plugin n/a. Message explains how to turn off.

mods.name: mock-server
mods.description: /mock starts a fake API server from your OpenAPI spec so you can build the frontend before the backend.
mods.spec: /mock [spec] [port]: start `npx @stoplight/prism-cli mock <spec> -p <port>` via $.process.spawn (or fallback: tiny built-in mock using node -e script generated at runtime that serves examples from the spec as JSON). Status shows '🧪 mock :4010'; Pane with recent requests from output; /mock stop. Stop on session.end.

mods.name: rate-limit-guard
mods.description: Stops Claude from hammering external APIs with curl loops.
mods.spec: Track Bash calls hitting external http(s) hosts (curl/wget/http/httpie) per host in a sliding 60s window; above userConfig N (default 20) deny further calls to that host for 60s with message. Also detect `for`/`while` loops containing curl in a single command and add a context warning.

mods.name: jwt-decode
mods.description: /jwt decodes a JSON Web Token locally — header, claims, expiry — without sending it anywhere.
mods.spec: /jwt <token> (or selection/clipboard? selection via $.ui.selection): base64url-decode header and payload, pretty JSON, show iat/nbf/exp as dates with 'expired N min ago'/'valid for', alg warnings (none, HS256 with weak?). Never logs/stores the token. Output via command text.

mods.name: status-check
mods.description: /status checks whether GitHub, npm, PyPI or the Anthropic API are having an outage before you blame your code.
mods.spec: /status: fetch Statuspage JSON endpoints (https://www.githubstatus.com/api/v2/status.json, https://status.npmjs.org/api/v2/status.json, https://status.anthropic.com/api/v2/status.json, https://status.python.org/api/v2/status.json, plus userConfig extra) in parallel with timeouts; show indicator per service. Also: when a Bash command fails with network-ish errors (ETIMEDOUT, 503 from registry), check the relevant status page and add a context note if there's an incident.

mods.name: graphql-context
mods.description: Gives Claude a compact summary of your GraphQL schema when you work on queries and resolvers.
mods.spec: Find schema (*.graphql, schema.gql, introspection json, codegen config). Parse types/queries/mutations (lightweight SDL parser: type/input/enum/interface/union blocks, fields with args and types). When prompt or edited files involve .graphql/gql`` or resolvers, add prompt.submit context (once per conversation) with compact schema (Query/Mutation fields + referenced types, capped). /gql-schema shows it.

mods.name: curl-to-code
mods.description: /curl2code turns a curl command into fetch, axios, Python requests or Go code.
mods.spec: /curl2code [lang] <curl ...>: parse curl args (-X, -H, -d/--data/--data-raw/--json, -u, -F, URL, --compressed, -k) into a request model; emit code for fetch (default, or detect project language), axios, python requests, go net/http. Return fenced code; Button-less (command text). Pure parser module with tests.

mods.name: scope-lock
mods.description: /scope locks Claude to the files you name; edits outside the scope are blocked.
mods.spec: /scope <glob...> sets allowed globs in $.state (also /scope off, /scope show); status '🔒 scope: src/auth/**'. Guard Edit/Write/NotebookEdit and Bash write targets (simple redirection/mv/cp/rm parsing) outside allowed globs -> deny with scope info. prompt.compose section telling the model the scope. Implement glob matching (**, *, ?) in a pure module.

mods.name: second-opinion
mods.description: /second-opinion has a different model critique Claude's last answer or plan.
mods.spec: /second-opinion [focus]: collect last assistant answer + the user prompt it answered (+ diff of files edited in that turn, capped); $.model.complete with a different model (userConfig, default the 'other' tier: if session model is opus use sonnet, else opus) and a critical-review system prompt; Pane shows agreement level, concerns, suggestions, Buttons 'Send to Claude' and Copy.

mods.name: parallel-explore
mods.description: /explore sends three subagents to investigate different parts of the codebase and merges their findings.
mods.spec: /explore <question>: decide 3 angles via $.model.complete (or fixed: 'where is it implemented', 'how is it tested/used', 'related config/docs'); $.agent.spawn three read-only Explore-type agents (use built-in subagent type if available; inspect types) in parallel; show progress in Pane; when done, merge via $.model.complete into one answer with file references; Button 'Send to Claude'.

mods.name: subagent-cap
mods.description: Caps how many subagents can run at the same time.
mods.spec: Guard Agent/Task tool calls: count running agents via $.agent.list() (or track spawn/complete events); deny when >= userConfig max (default 3) with message to wait or raise the cap. Status shows 'agents 2/3'.

mods.name: task-queue
mods.description: /queue lines up prompts that run one after another whenever Claude is free.
mods.spec: /queue add <prompt>, /queue list, /queue remove <n>, /queue clear, /queue pause|resume. Stored in $.store per project. On turn.complete (main loop, not aborted) and when idle, $.prompt.submit the next item (as user's words), mark running; status '⏭ queue 3'. Pane /queue shows items with up/down/remove Buttons.

mods.name: night-shift
mods.description: Runs your queued tasks at a scheduled time, like overnight, and leaves you a report.
mods.spec: /night-shift at <HH:MM> | now | off, uses task-queue's own store? (cannot read other plugins' store) -> keeps its own queue: /night-shift add <prompt>. $.clock.every(60s) checks time; when due and session idle, submits items one by one (each after previous turn.complete), records outcome (duration, files changed via git diff --stat, last answer summary) and writes .claude/night-shift/<date>.md report; toast in the morning on next prompt. Safety: refuses to start if git tree is dirty unless userConfig allowDirty.

mods.name: loop-breaker
mods.description: Stops Claude when it repeats the same failing command three times and suggests a different approach.
mods.spec: Track Bash commands (normalized) and their failure; also identical Edit attempts failing. On the 3rd identical failing call within a turn, deny further identical calls with a message telling the model to step back, read the error, and try a different approach; toast to the user. Reset on prompt.submit.

mods.name: self-check
mods.description: At the end of each editing turn, has the model double-check it actually did what you asked.
mods.spec: On turn.complete of main-loop turns that edited files (and not triggered by itself): $.model.fork with a checklist prompt: did it satisfy each requirement of the user's last prompt, any TODOs left, tests run? Expect JSON {complete:boolean, gaps:[...]}. If gaps, band with the gaps and Buttons 'Fix gaps' ($.prompt.submit listing them) / Dismiss. userConfig mode notify|auto (auto submits once, max 1 round).

mods.name: edit-limit
mods.description: Asks for confirmation when a single turn tries to modify more than N files.
mods.spec: Count distinct files modified via Edit/Write/NotebookEdit in the current turn; when about to exceed userConfig max (default 15), deny with message asking the model to summarise its plan and ask the user; allow if the latest prompt contains 'EDITS-OK' or after the user raises the cap via /edit-limit <n>.

mods.name: agent-presets
mods.description: Ready-made subagents for focused jobs: debugger, test writer, doc writer and migrator.
mods.spec: $.agent.register four agent types with carefully written prompts and minimal tool sets: debugger (reproduce, isolate, minimal fix, regression test), test-writer (tests only, no src edits), doc-writer (docs/README/docstrings only), migrator (mechanical refactors across files with verification). Also a tool.call guard enforcing each preset's write scope for calls made by those agents (agentId tracking). /presets lists them with how to invoke.

mods.name: explain-diff
mods.description: /explain-diff explains in plain words what changed in the last turn and why.
mods.spec: Track files edited in the last turn with before/after (git diff for tracked files or captured old/new strings). /explain-diff [level]: $.model.complete (or fork for context) to explain per file: what changed, why, risks, how to test; beginner|expert level. Pane with Markdown and per-file Code diff toggles.

mods.name: quiz-me
mods.description: /quiz asks you questions about the code Claude just wrote, to check you really understand it.
mods.spec: /quiz [n]: based on last turn's diff (or a file argument), $.model.complete generates n multiple-choice questions JSON {q, options[4], answer, why}. Pane shows one question at a time with option Buttons, feedback and explanation, score at end; store score history in $.store; /quiz stats.

mods.name: learning-mode
mods.description: Claude explains the why behind each change and leaves small TODOs for you to complete yourself.
mods.spec: /learning on|off; when on, prompt.compose adds instructions: explain reasoning briefly, and for small well-scoped pieces leave `TODO(you):` markers with hints instead of writing them (max 2 per task), never in security-critical code. Status '🎓 learning'. On turn.complete count TODO(you) added and toast.

mods.name: onboarding-tour
mods.description: /tour walks a newcomer through the repository step by step.
mods.spec: /tour: build an outline (entry points, main modules, data flow, how to run tests) via $.model.fork or from codebase scan (README, package.json scripts, top-level dirs) with $.model.complete; Pane shows step N of M with title, explanation (Markdown), file references with Buttons 'Open in prompt' (@path), Next/Back; progress saved in $.store so /tour resumes.

mods.name: command-coach
mods.description: Suggests Claude Code commands and mods that fit the way you work.
mods.spec: Observe patterns: many long Bash outputs -> suggest output-trimmer; repeated manual git commits -> /commit; frequent 'run the tests' prompts -> quick-commands; high context -> /compact; long sessions -> /resume-brief etc. At most one tip per session (or per 2 hours), via toast, with a rule table in a pure module; /coach shows all current suggestions. Track shown tips in $.store to avoid repeats.

mods.name: shortcut-tips
mods.description: One tip a day about Claude Code shortcuts and features you might not know.
mods.spec: At session.start, if not shown today, toast a tip from a built-in list of ~40 accurate Claude Code tips (keyboard shortcuts like esc esc, ctrl+o, ctrl+r, shift+tab modes, @ mentions, # memory, ! bash mode, /compact, /resume, /rewind, /add-dir, /model, /agents, /hooks, /plugin, /mods). Only include tips you can verify from the types or `claude --help` output; store index in $.store; /tip shows the next one.

mods.name: why-log
mods.description: Records why each file was changed; /why shows the reasoning behind any file's edits.
mods.spec: On each successful Edit/Write record {file, time, turn prompt (first 200 chars), short rationale}. Rationale: at turn.complete, $.model.complete over the last assistant text + edited file list to produce one-line reason per file (batch, small model). Store per project in $.store (cap 2000). /why <file> lists the history; /why shows last turn.

mods.name: cheatsheet
mods.description: /cheat shows a quick reference for git, docker, regex, tmux and more, offline.
mods.spec: /cheat <topic> [query]: embedded concise cheatsheets (git, docker, regex, tmux, vim, bash, sql, curl, kubectl, npm) as Markdown in pure modules; filter lines by query; /cheat lists topics. No network.

mods.name: pair-mode
mods.description: Claude proposes, you type: edits become diffs you apply yourself, for deliberate practice.
mods.spec: /pair on|off. When on: deny Edit/Write/NotebookEdit with a message instructing the model to present the change as a unified diff in its answer for the user to apply; prompt.compose section explaining pair mode. Band shows 'Pair mode: you drive' with Off Button. /pair check runs git diff to show what the user changed and asks Claude ($.prompt.submit) to review it.

mods.name: skill-tracker
mods.description: Tracks which languages and tools you've worked with each week.
mods.spec: On successful Edit/Write record file extension -> language and Bash tool names (git, docker, kubectl, npm, cargo...) counts per ISO week in $.store. /skills shows this week and last 8 weeks top languages/tools as text bars.

mods.name: license-checker
mods.description: Warns when a dependency with a copyleft license (GPL, AGPL) lands in a permissively licensed project.
mods.spec: Read project license (LICENSE file / package.json license / pyproject). On npm/pnpm/yarn add and pip install commands (after success) look up each package's license: npm registry metadata, PyPI JSON (info.license / classifiers) via $.http.fetch with timeout; if GPL/AGPL/LGPL/SSPL/unknown and project is MIT/Apache/BSD, toast + context note. Cache results in $.store.

mods.name: pii-in-logs
mods.description: Flags log statements that print emails, passwords, tokens or other personal data.
mods.spec: After edits: added logging calls (console.*, logger.*, log.*, print, puts, fmt.Print*, System.out) whose arguments reference identifiers like password, passwd, secret, token, apiKey, ssn, creditCard, email, phone, dob, req.body, user (whole object). Context note per line; userConfig block mode.

mods.name: data-map
mods.description: /data-map lists where your code collects, stores and sends personal data — a head start for GDPR.
mods.spec: /data-map: grep project for personal-data signals (form fields/models with email, name, phone, address, birth, ip, location, cookie, analytics calls, third-party SDKs) and storage/sending sinks; then $.model.complete to organise into a table: data item, where collected (file:line), where stored, sent to, legal-basis hint. Pane + Save to docs/data-map.md.

mods.name: tracker-guard
mods.description: Blocks adding analytics and tracking SDKs that haven't been approved.
mods.spec: Guard installs (npm/pnpm/yarn add, pip install, script tags in edits) of known tracking packages (google-analytics, gtag, @segment, mixpanel, amplitude, hotjar, fullstory, posthog, @sentry? (no—error tracking allowed by default), facebook pixel, tiktok, clarity) and Edit/Write adding their script URLs. userConfig approved list. Deny with reason.

mods.name: no-upload
mods.description: Blocks commands that upload files to external services like pastebins and file-sharing sites.
mods.spec: tool.call on Bash: curl/wget with -F/--upload-file/-T/--data-binary @file to non-allowlisted hosts; known paste/share hosts (pastebin, transfer.sh, 0x0.st, file.io, gist create via gh with secrets?, termbin via nc); scp/rsync to remote hosts not in allowlist. Deny unless prompt contains 'UPLOAD-OK'. userConfig allowHosts.

mods.name: crypto-guard
mods.description: Flags weak cryptography: MD5 or SHA1 for passwords, Math.random for tokens, ECB mode, hard-coded IVs.
mods.spec: After edits: md5/sha1 used near password/hash context, createHash('md5'|'sha1'), hashlib.md5/sha1, Math.random()/random.random() for token/secret/id/otp/nonce, AES ECB, static IV/nonce literals, bcrypt rounds < 10, jwt alg none, verify=False/rejectUnauthorized:false. Context note; userConfig block.

mods.name: sbom
mods.description: /sbom generates a software bill of materials with every dependency and its license.
mods.spec: /sbom [cyclonedx|spdx|md]: read lockfiles (package-lock.json v2/v3, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, poetry.lock, uv.lock, requirements.txt, Cargo.lock, go.sum) with pure parsers to list name@version; licenses from node_modules/*/package.json when present, else 'unknown' (optional registry lookup with userConfig). Write sbom.cdx.json (CycloneDX 1.5 minimal valid) or Markdown table; Pane summary with license counts.

mods.name: audit-trail
mods.description: Writes every action Claude takes to an append-only JSONL audit log.
mods.spec: Hook tool.call (after next) and prompt.submit and turn.complete: append JSON lines {ts, session, kind, tool, summary of input (paths, command truncated), outcome (ok/error/denied), user prompt hash or text per userConfig} to .claude/audit/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl via $.fs (append = read+write or append API if exists). Redact secrets with simple patterns. /audit shows today's count and path.

mods.name: vuln-scan
mods.description: After installs, runs npm audit or pip-audit and shows any vulnerabilities in a pane.
mods.spec: After successful dependency installs (npm/pnpm/yarn install|add, pip install, uv add, poetry add, cargo add) run the right auditor with --json (npm audit --json, pnpm audit --json, pip-audit -f json, cargo audit --json if installed) with timeout; parse severities; status '🛡 2 high'; Pane /vulns listing package, severity, advisory, fix version, Button 'Ask Claude to fix'.

mods.name: copyright-guard
mods.description: Flags pasted code that carries someone else's license or copyright header.
mods.spec: After Edit/Write: added text containing 'Copyright (c)', 'SPDX-License-Identifier', 'Licensed under', 'GNU General Public License', 'All rights reserved' where holder/license differs from the project's (read LICENSE and package.json). Context note asking to verify provenance; toast.

mods.name: benchmark-compare
mods.description: /bench runs your benchmarks before and after a change and compares the numbers.
mods.spec: /bench [command]: detect benchmark command (package.json bench script, vitest bench, pytest-benchmark, go test -bench, cargo bench, hyperfine). /bench baseline stores results (parse ops/sec, ns/op, mean ms per benchmark) in $.store per project+branch; /bench runs again and shows a Pane table with deltas colored (regression > userConfig %).

mods.name: slow-test-flag
mods.description: Points out your slowest tests after each test run.
mods.spec: After test-runner Bash commands complete, parse durations from output (jest/vitest per-test ms with --verbose or file times, pytest --durations output, go test per-package times, cargo test timings if present) and show the top 5 slowest in a toast/status; /slow-tests lists the last run's top 10. If runner lacks durations, suggest the flag (pytest --durations=10).

mods.name: flaky-detector
mods.description: Detects tests that pass and fail at random and keeps a list of the suspects.
mods.spec: Parse failing test names from runner output (jest/vitest/pytest/go/cargo/rspec). Record per test pass/fail history in $.store per project (only when the file wasn't edited between runs: track edit times). A test that failed and later passed with no edits to it or its source in between is marked flaky. /flaky Pane lists suspects with flip counts; context note when a known flaky test fails ('known flaky').

mods.name: leak-hint
mods.description: Flags event listeners, intervals and subscriptions created without cleanup.
mods.spec: After edits: in React useEffect bodies adding addEventListener/setInterval/setTimeout/subscribe/on( without a returned cleanup; in classes/components adding listeners without matching remove in dispose/componentWillUnmount/onDestroy; Node: process.on/emitter.on in request handlers. Context note.

mods.name: outdated-deps
mods.description: /outdated shows stale dependencies and how risky each upgrade is.
mods.spec: /outdated: run npm/pnpm/yarn outdated --json, pip list --outdated --format=json (in venv), cargo outdated if installed, go list -u -m -json all; classify patch/minor/major (semver), flag deprecated packages; Pane table sorted by risk with Buttons 'Upgrade all patch/minor' (submits prompt to Claude to do it and run tests) and per-row Copy command.

mods.name: profile-run
mods.description: /profile runs a command under a profiler and shows the hottest functions.
mods.spec: /profile <command>: node -> `node --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-dir=.claude/profiles` then parse .cpuprofile (aggregate self time per function, top 15); python -> `python -m cProfile -o file` then `python -c pstats` to print top cumulative; go -> suggest pprof. Pane table: function, file:line, self ms, total %; Button 'Ask Claude to optimise top 3'.

mods.name: net-retry
mods.description: Automatically retries commands that failed because of a temporary network error.
mods.spec: tool.call on Bash: await next; if failed and output matches transient patterns (ETIMEDOUT, ECONNRESET, EAI_AGAIN, 'network timeout', 'Could not resolve host', 502/503/504 from registries, 'Temporary failure in name resolution') and the command is idempotent-ish (installs, git fetch/pull/clone, curl GET, docker pull), retry up to userConfig (default 2) with backoff via $.clock.sleep (budget-aware), returning the last result plus a context note listing retries.

mods.name: disk-guard
mods.description: Warns when the disk is nearly full before builds, installs and docker pulls.
mods.spec: Before Bash commands that write lots (install, build, docker build/pull, cargo build, git clone): `df -Pk .` parse available; if < userConfig GB (default 2) or > 95% used, add context note + toast with top space hogs suggestion (node_modules, ~/.cache, docker system df). Cache df result 60s.

mods.name: regression-guard
mods.description: Remembers which tests passed at the start of the session and warns if any of them now fail.
