mods.spec: Parse test results (names + pass/fail) from test-runner outputs. First full run in session = baseline (store set of passing names). Later runs: any baseline-passing test now failing -> band 'Regressions: N' listing names with Button 'Ask Claude to fix regressions'; status '⚠ 2 regressions'. /baseline reset.

mods.name: watch-mode-guard
mods.description: Blocks watch-mode and never-ending commands run in the foreground, where they'd hang the turn.
mods.spec: tool.call on Bash (not run_in_background): jest --watch/--watchAll, vitest without run/--run (when vitest default is watch in non-CI), tsc -w/--watch, nodemon, webpack --watch, npm run dev/start/serve, vite (dev), next dev, rails s, docker compose up without -d, tail -f, python -m http.server. Deny suggesting run_in_background: true or the non-watch variant (vitest run, jest --ci).

mods.name: mod-maker
mods.description: /new-mod scaffolds a new Claude Code mod with manifest, hooks, test and README, ready to fill in.
mods.spec: /new-mod <name> [description] [--kind guard|status|pane|command]: write mods/<name> (if cwd is a claude-mods-style repo with mods/) or ./<name> with .claude-plugin/plugin.json, hooks/hooks.json, hooks/register.ts(x) template for the chosen kind, tests/register.test.ts that passes, README.md template, types/index.d.ts for pane kind. Validate name (kebab, not existing). Then run `claude plugin validate` and report. Templates must themselves pass validate/test — verify by generating each kind in the scratchpad and running check-mod.sh.

mods.name: mod-doctor
mods.description: /mod-doctor checks your installed mods for outdated versions, conflicts and load errors.
mods.spec: /mod-doctor: `claude plugin list --json` (+ marketplace list) via $.process.run; for each claude-mods plugin compare installed version vs marketplace.json (fetch raw from GitHub, cache); detect known conflicts (table: e.g. output-trimmer + redactor both rewrite results — fine; two plugins registering the same command name -> from `claude plugin list` details if available; multiple status-line mods) and disabled plugins; read debug hints if available. Pane report with severity and fix actions (update via CLI, disable).

mods.name: mod-profiles
mods.description: Switch between sets of mods — work, personal, demo — with one command.
mods.spec: /profile-mods save <name> (records currently enabled plugins from `claude plugin list --json`), /profile-mods use <name> (enable/disable via `claude plugin enable|disable <id>` to match, then suggest /reload-plugins or run it via $.command.run), /profile-mods list|delete. Stored in $.store. Never touches non-plugin settings. Pane for list with Use buttons.

mods.name: settings-sync
mods.description: Exports and imports your mods' configuration so you can move it between machines.
mods.spec: /mods-export writes a JSON of pluginConfigs entries for installed claude-mods plugins (read ~/.claude/settings.json via $.fs; exclude userConfig fields marked secret / keys containing token|secret|key|password) to ~/claude-mods-settings.json; /mods-import <path> merges them back into ~/.claude/settings.json after showing a summary and requiring '/mods-import <path> --yes'. Back up settings.json first.

mods.name: quiet-mode
mods.description: /quiet silences toasts and sounds from every mod while you focus.
mods.spec: /quiet [minutes] toggles $.state; while on, hook ui.toast and audio.play events (all plugins' calls pass through the chain; inspect types for how to intercept another plugin's $.ui.toast — e.g. on('ui.toast') returning without next) to drop them, except this plugin's own; status '🔕 quiet 25m'; auto-off timer. If intercepting other plugins' toasts is impossible, document the limitation honestly.

mods.name: achievements
mods.description: Unlock achievements as you work: first commit, 100 green test runs, a week-long streak and more.
mods.spec: Define ~25 achievements in a pure table (first commit via Claude, 10/100 commits, 100 green test runs, first PR description, zero-error day, 7-day streak, night owl (after midnight), refactor 20 files, first mod installed via mod-store...) with progress counters in $.store (global). Hook relevant events to increment. Unlock -> toast '🏆 Unlocked: X' (+ optional sound). /achievements Pane grid with locked/unlocked and progress bars.

mods.name: streaks
mods.description: Shows your consecutive days of coding with Claude in the status line.
mods.spec: Record active local dates (a prompt sent) in $.store; compute current and longest streak; status '🔥 12-day streak' shown at session start for 10 seconds then cleared (userConfig persistent); toast on milestones (7, 30, 100). /streak shows calendar of last 30 days.

mods.name: soundpack
mods.description: Sound packs for Claude Code events: minimal, retro or nature.
mods.spec: Generate small valid WAV assets programmatically for 3 packs × 4 events (turn done, error, permission needed, tests green) — keep total assets < 600KB. userConfig pack + per-event toggles + volume. Hook turn.complete (long turns), Bash errors, classic.PermissionRequest/Notification, test green. Play non-blocking. Note macOS-only playback honestly.

mods.name: daily-goal
mods.description: /goal sets today's goal, keeps it in view above the prompt and asks at day's end if you got there.
mods.spec: /goal <text> stores today's goal per project in $.store; AbovePrompt band shows '🎯 Goal: …' with Buttons Done / Edit / Hide; prompt.compose adds the goal as context (session scope, short). On first session after 18:00 (userConfig) or next day start, ask via band whether it was achieved; keep a history; /goal history shows last 14 days with ✓/✗.

mods.name: session-replay
mods.description: /replay steps through the session — prompts, tool calls, edits — in a pane, like a video timeline.
mods.spec: Build a timeline from $.session.messages() (prompts, assistant texts, tool uses with inputs) plus own recorded tool results/durations. /replay Pane: one step per page with type icon, time, content (Markdown for text, Code for commands/diffs), Prev/Next/First/Last Buttons and hotkeys, step counter, filter by type (Select). Export /replay export writes .claude/replays/<ts>.md.
